title: Evaluating Robustness of Counterfactual Explanations
reasoning: The paper's central thesis connects the technical concept of 'robustness' in counterfactual explanations directly to the ethical concept of 'individual fairness'. It argues that a lack of robustness is a form of unfairness, stating that unstable explanations can be considered 'individually unfair'. This is not a peripheral discussion but a core part of the paper's motivation and analysis, particularly in Section III-E, which is dedicated to the 'Relation to Individual Fairness'.
